text.div:
SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD

  • Neurology consultation for seizure classification, EEG and MRI review, and the choice of antiseizure medicine
  • Antiseizure medicine: lamotrigine with slow titration, rash teaching, 30-day supplies, a pill organizer and phone alarms, a seizure diary, and levels only when they would change care
  • Seizure safety at every visit: triggers (sleep loss, alcohol, overwork), showers rather than baths, no swimming or heights alone, no driving until seizure-free and cleared by his neurologist, a written seizure action plan for friends, and a SUDEP discussion
  • Gambling-disorder treatment: cognitive behavioral therapy with a gambling-disorder therapist, self-exclusion, a bank gambling block, Gamblers Anonymous, and free debt counseling
  • Mood and safety: PHQ-9 at intake and every two to four months, GAD-7 at intake and with any change, and a suicide-risk review with the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline at every visit
  • Bone health: baseline vitamin D; lamotrigine is not an enzyme inducer, so no DXA scan is needed unless an enzyme-inducing medicine is added

resource.title: Fyodor Dostoevsky synthetic care plan
resource.description: Primary-care and neurology management of long-untreated epilepsy in a 43-year-old man (ILAE classification when the onset cannot be determined, routine and sleep-deprived EEG, epilepsy-protocol MRI, antiseizure medicine choice with slow lamotrigine titration and rash teaching, a seizure diary, trigger management, seizure safety and driving counseling, SUDEP discussion, bone health, and mood screening because depression is common in epilepsy) together with gambling-disorder care (a validated screen, cognitive behavioral therapy, self-exclusion, financial safeguards, peer support, and structured suicide-risk assessment with the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline), including an honest account of a breakthrough seizure and a gambling lapse, on the AAN/AES and ILAE guidance, the CMID depression monograph, and current gambling-disorder evidence.
